	local function collectLocals()
		local i=1
		while i<=#toks do
			local t, nxt = getTok(i)
			if not t then break end

			if t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="local" then

				end
				tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value==")") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then
						nameMap[tj.value]=newVar()
					end
					tj, j = getTok(j+1)
				end
			elseif (t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for") then
				local nj = i+1
				local tj, j = getTok(nj)
				while tj and not (tj.type=="keyword" and tj.value=="in") and not (tj.type=="punctuation" and tj.value=="=") do
					if tj.type=="identifier" and not PROTECTED[tj.value] and not nameMap[tj.value] then

					end
					local tComma, nk = getTok(j+1)
					if tComma and tComma.type=="punctuation" and tComma.value=="," then
						tj, j = getTok(nk+1)

			t.raw = newName
			t.length = #newName
			result[#result+1]=t
		else

		end
	end
	return result
end

local function parseAST(toks)

	local function Pv(n)
		local tmp = tp

			c = c + 1

	local function adv()
		tp=tp+1

	end
	local function chk(t,v) if v then return T().type==t and T().value==v end return T().type==t end
	local function eat(t,v)
		if not chk(t,v) then error("Expected "..t..(v and " '"..v.."'" or "").." got "..T().type.." '"..tostring(T().value).."'") end
		local r=T(); adv(); return r
	end
	local function try(t,v) if chk(t,v) then adv(); return true end end

	local parseExpr,parseStat,parseBlock,parseFB

	local BOPS={["or"]=1,["and"]=2,["<"]=3,[">"]=3,["<="]=3,[">="]=3,["=="]=3,["~="]=3,
		[".."]=4,["+"]=5,["-"]=5,["*"]=6,["/"]=6,["%"]=6,["//"]=6,["^"]=7}
	local RASS={["^"]=true,[".."]=true}
	local ENDS={["end"]=1,["else"]=1,["elseif"]=1,["until"]=1,["eof"]=1}

	local function pSfx(base)

			if chk("punctuation",".") then

			elseif chk("punctuation","[") then

			elseif chk("punctuation","(") then

				if not chk("punctuation",")") then

					while try("punctuation",",") do args[#args+1]=parseExpr() end
				end

				base = { type="CallExpression", base=base, arguments=args, isSelf=false }

		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="true" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=true }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="false" then adv(); return { type="Literal", kind="boolean", value=false }

		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="..." then adv(); return { type="VarargLiteral" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="function" then adv(); return parseFB()
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(" then
			adv(); local e=parseExpr(); eat("punctuation",")"); return pSfx(e)
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="not" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="not", argument=pPrim() }
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="-" then adv(); return { type="UnaryExpression", operator="-", argument=pPrim() }

		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="return" then
			adv(); local args={}

		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="while" then
			adv(); local cond=parseExpr(); eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
			return { type="WhileStatement", condition=cond, body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="repeat" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","until"); local cond=parseExpr()
			return { type="RepeatUntilStatement", body=body, condition=cond }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="for" then
			adv(); local vn=eat("identifier").value

				eat("keyword","in"); local iters={}

				eat("keyword","do"); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end")
				return { type="ForGenericStatement", variables=names, iterators=iters, body=body }
			end
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="do" then
			adv(); local body=parseBlock(); eat("keyword","end"); return { type="DoStatement", body=body }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="break" then
			adv(); return { type="BreakStatement" }
		elseif t.type=="keyword" and t.value=="continue" then
			adv(); return { type="ContinueStatement" }
						elseif t.type=="identifier" or (t.type=="punctuation" and t.value=="(") then

			local isCompound = false
			local cOp = ""
			local nxtVal = T().value
			
			if (nxtVal=="+" or nxtVal=="-" or nxtVal=="*" or nxtVal=="/" or nxtVal=="%" or nxtVal=="^" or nxtVal=="..") and Pt(2)=="punctuation" and Pv(2)=="=" then

			end

			if isCompound then

				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				try("punctuation",";")
				rhs[1] = { type="BinaryExpression", operator=cOp, left=firstExpr, right=rhs[1] }
				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs={firstExpr}, rhs=rhs }
			elseif chk("punctuation","=") or chk("punctuation",",") then

				while try("punctuation",",") do lhs[#lhs+1] = parseExpr() end
				eat("punctuation","=")
				local rhs = { parseExpr() }
				while try("punctuation",",") do rhs[#rhs+1] = parseExpr() end

				return { type="AssignmentStatement", lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs }
			else

			end
		elseif t.type=="punctuation" and t.value==";" then adv()
		else adv() end
		try("punctuation",";")
	end

	parseBlock = function()
		local block = {}
		while Tt()~="eof" and not (Tt()=="keyword" and ENDS[Tv()]) do
			local s=parseStat()
			if s then block[#block+1]=s end
		end

	end

	return { type="Chunk", body=parseBlock() }
end

						local function newP(np, parent) return {c={},k={},ki={},np=np or 0,mr=np or 0,sc={{}},lc=np or 0,pr={},va=false,sub_c={},loopStack={},upvalues={},parent=parent} end
	
		local function getOrAddStrKey(p, str)
		local lookup = "enc_str:"..str
		if p.ki[lookup] ~= nil then
			return p.ki[lookup], p.k[p.ki[lookup]+1].key
		end
		local k_key = math.random(1, 255) + (#str * math.random(1, 255))
		local k_obj = {type="enc_string", val=str, key=k_key}
		local i = #p.k
		p.k[i+1] = k_obj
		p.ki[lookup] = i
		return i, k_key
	end

	local function addK(p,v)
		local key=type(v)..":"..tostring(v)
		if p.ki[key]~=nil then return p.ki[key] end
		local i=#p.k; p.k[i+1]=v; p.ki[key]=i; return i
	end
	
	local function emit(p,...) p.c[#p.c+1]={...}; return #p.c-1 end
	local function patch(p,i,t2) p.c[i+1][2]=t2 end
	local function aR(p) local r=p.lc; p.lc=r+1; if p.lc>p.mr then p.mr=p.lc end; return r end
	local function fR(p) p.lc=p.lc-1 end
	local function nL(p,n) local r=aR(p); p.sc[#p.sc][#p.sc[#p.sc]+1]={n=n,r=r}; return r end
		local function fL(p,n)
		for s=#p.sc,1,-1 do
			for i=#p.sc[s],1,-1 do
				if p.sc[s][i].n==n then return p.sc[s][i].r end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function resolveUpval(p, name)
		if not p.parent then return nil end
		local r = fL(p.parent, name)
		if r then
			for i, uv in ipairs(p.upvalues) do
				if uv.isLocal and uv.index == r then return i - 1 end
			end
			table.insert(p.upvalues, {isLocal = true, index = r})
			return #p.upvalues - 1
		end
		local ur = resolveUpval(p.parent, name)
		if ur then
			for i, uv in ipairs(p.upvalues) do
				if not uv.isLocal and uv.index == ur then return i - 1 end
			end
			table.insert(p.upvalues, {isLocal = false, index = ur})
			return #p.upvalues - 1
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function pushS(p) p.sc[#p.sc+1]={} end
	local function popS(p) local s=p.sc[#p.sc]; p.lc=p.lc-#s; p.sc[#p.sc]=nil end

	local function emitPUSH_REG(p, reg) return emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_REG, reg) end
	local function emitPUSH_K(p, k_idx) return emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_K, k_idx) end
	local function emitPUSH_LIT(p, val) return emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_LIT, val) end
	local function eJMP(p, target) local i=emitPUSH_LIT(p, target); emit(p, OC.M_JMP); return i end

	local function emitMOVE(p, dst, src)
		emit(p, OC.M_FETCH_REG_ID, src)
		emit(p, OC.M_WRITE_REG, dst)
	end

	local function emitALU(p, op, dst, src1, src2)
		emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_REG, src1)
		emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_REG, src2)
		emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_B)
		emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_A)
		emit(p, op)
		emit(p, OC.M_WRITE_REG, dst)
	end

	local function emitALU_UNARY(p, op, dst, src)
		emit(p, OC.M_PUSH_REG, src)
		emit(p, op)
		emit(p, OC.M_WRITE_REG, dst)
	end

			local function eCmp(p,op,dst,B,C)
		emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1); emitPUSH_REG(p, B); emitPUSH_REG(p, C); emit(p, op)
		local j1=eJMP(p, 0)
		emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_LOADBOOL, dst)
		local j2=eJMP(p, 0)
		patch(p, j1, #p.c + 1)
		emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_LOADBOOL, dst)
		patch(p, j2, #p.c + 1)
	end

			local function emitLOADK_NonLinearMBA(p, dst, val)
		if type(val) == "number" and val == math.floor(val) and val >= 0 and val <= 2147483647 then
			local xkey = math.random(1, 65535)
			local enc = bit32.bxor(math.floor(val), xkey)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, enc)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, xkey)
			emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_B)
			emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_A)
			emit(p, OC.M_ALU_BXOR)
			emit(p, OC.M_WRITE_REG, dst)
		else
			local mask = math.random(10, 9999)
			local enc_val = val - mask
			local k_idx = #p.k
			p.k[k_idx + 1] = enc_val
			p.ki["__enc_flt_" .. k_idx] = k_idx
			emitPUSH_K(p, k_idx)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, mask)
			emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_B)
			emit(p, OC.M_POP_ALU_A)
			emit(p, OC.M_ALU_ADD)
			emit(p, OC.M_WRITE_REG, dst)
		end
	end

	local compileExpr, compileStat, compileBlock

	compileExpr = function(p, node, dst)
						if node.type == "Literal" then
			if node.kind == "number" then emitLOADK_NonLinearMBA(p, dst, node.value)
			elseif node.kind == "string" then 
				local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, node.value)
				emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, dst, strKey)
			elseif node.kind == "boolean" then emitPUSH_LIT(p, node.value and 1 or 0); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_LOADBOOL, dst)
			elseif node.kind == "nil" then emitPUSH_LIT(p, dst); emitPUSH_LIT(p, dst); emit(p, OC.M_LOADNIL) end
		elseif node.type == "VarargLiteral" then
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, dst); emitPUSH_LIT(p, dst); emit(p, OC.M_LOADNIL)
								elseif node.type == "FunctionDefinition" then
			local fp=newP(#node.params, p); fp.va=node.isVararg
			pushS(fp)
			for i, pn in ipairs(node.params) do 
				local r = i - 1
				fp.sc[#fp.sc][#fp.sc[#fp.sc]+1] = {n = pn, r = r}
			end
			compileBlock(fp, node.body)
			popS(fp)
			emitPUSH_LIT(fp, 0); emitPUSH_LIT(fp, 0); emit(fp, OC.M_RETURN)
			local pi=#p.pr; p.pr[pi+1]=fp
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, pi); emit(p, OC.M_CLOSURE, dst)
				elseif node.type == "Identifier" then
			local r=fL(p, node.name)
			if r then if dst~=r then emitMOVE(p, dst, r) end
			else 
				local u = resolveUpval(p, node.name)
				if u then
					emitPUSH_LIT(p, u)
					emit(p, OC.M_GETUPVAL, dst)
				else
					local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, node.name)
					emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emit(p, OC.M_GETGLOBAL, dst, strKey) 
				end
			end
		elseif node.type == "UnaryExpression" then
			compileExpr(p, node.argument, dst)
			if node.operator == "not" then emitALU_UNARY(p, OC.M_ALU_NOT, dst, dst)
			elseif node.operator == "-" then emitALU_UNARY(p, OC.M_ALU_UNM, dst, dst)
			elseif node.operator == "#" then emitALU_UNARY(p, OC.M_ALU_LEN, dst, dst)
			elseif node.operator == "~" then emitALU_UNARY(p, OC.M_ALU_BNOT, dst, dst) end
		elseif node.type == "TableLiteral" then
			emit(p, OC.M_NEWTABLE, dst)
			local idx=1
			for _, field in ipairs(node.fields) do
				if field.key then
					local kr=aR(p); local vr=aR(p)
					compileExpr(p, field.key, kr); compileExpr(p, field.value, vr)
					emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emitPUSH_REG(p, vr); emit(p, OC.M_SETTABLE); fR(p); fR(p)
												else
					local kr=aR(p); local vr=aR(p)
					emitLOADK_NonLinearMBA(p, kr, idx); compileExpr(p, field.value, vr)
					emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emitPUSH_REG(p, vr); emit(p, OC.M_SETTABLE); fR(p); fR(p);
					idx=idx+1
				end
			end
		elseif node.type == "BinaryExpression" then
			compileExpr(p, node.left, dst)
			local rr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.right, rr)
			local op=node.operator
			if op=="+" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_ADD, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="-" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_SUB, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="*" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_MUL, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="/" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_DIV, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="%" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_MOD, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="^" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_POW, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op==".." then emitPUSH_LIT(p, dst); emitPUSH_LIT(p, rr); emit(p, OC.M_CONCAT, dst)
			elseif op=="//" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_IDIV, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="&" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_BAND, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="|" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_BOR, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="~" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_BXOR, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="<<" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_SHL, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op==">>" then emitALU(p, OC.M_ALU_SHR, dst, dst, rr)
			elseif op=="==" then eCmp(p,OC.M_EQ,dst,dst,rr)
						elseif op=="~=" then
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_REG(p, rr); emit(p, OC.M_EQ); local j=eJMP(p, 0)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_LOADBOOL, dst); local j2=eJMP(p, 0)
				patch(p,j,#p.c + 1); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_LOADBOOL, dst); patch(p,j2,#p.c + 1)
			elseif op=="<" then eCmp(p,OC.M_LT,dst,dst,rr)
			elseif op=="<=" then eCmp(p,OC.M_LE,dst,dst,rr)
			elseif op==">" then eCmp(p,OC.M_LT,dst,rr,dst)
			elseif op==">=" then eCmp(p,OC.M_LE,dst,rr,dst)
			elseif op=="and" then
				emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_TEST); local j=eJMP(p, 0)
				emitMOVE(p, dst, rr); patch(p,j,#p.c + 1)
			elseif op=="or" then
				emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1); emit(p, OC.M_TEST); local j=eJMP(p, 0)
				emitMOVE(p, dst, rr); patch(p,j,#p.c + 1)
			end
			fR(p)
		elseif node.type == "MemberExpression" then
			compileExpr(p, node.base, dst)
			local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, node.identifier)
			local kr=aR(p); emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, kr, strKey)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emit(p, OC.M_GETTABLE, dst); fR(p)
		elseif node.type == "IndexExpression" then
			compileExpr(p, node.base, dst)
			local kr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.index, kr)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, dst); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emit(p, OC.M_GETTABLE, dst); fR(p)
										elseif node.type == "CallExpression" then
			if node.isSelf then
				local t_base = aR(p)
				compileExpr(p, node.base, t_base)
				local sk = aR(p)
				local c_base = aR(p)
				local self_reserved = aR(p)
				
				local na = 1
				local string_args = {}
				for _, arg in ipairs(node.arguments) do
					local ar = aR(p)
					if arg.type == "Literal" and arg.kind == "string" then
						table.insert(string_args, {node = arg, reg = ar})
					else
						compileExpr(p, arg, ar)
					end
					na = na + 1
				end
				
				local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, node.method)
				emitPUSH_K(p, strID)
				emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, sk, strKey)
				
				emitPUSH_REG(p, t_base)
				emitPUSH_REG(p, sk)
				emit(p, OC.M_SELF, c_base)
				
				emit(p, OC.M_SECURE_ERASE, sk)
				
				for _, sArg in ipairs(string_args) do
					compileExpr(p, sArg.node, sArg.reg)
				end
				
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, c_base)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, na)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1)
				emit(p, OC.M_CALL)
				
				if dst ~= c_base then emitMOVE(p, dst, c_base) end
				
				for _, sArg in ipairs(string_args) do
					emit(p, OC.M_SECURE_ERASE, sArg.reg)
				end
				
				for _ = 1, na + 3 do fR(p) end
			else
				local c_base = aR(p)
				compileExpr(p, node.base, c_base)
				
				local na = 0
				local string_args = {}
				for _, arg in ipairs(node.arguments) do
					local ar = aR(p)
					if arg.type == "Literal" and arg.kind == "string" then
						table.insert(string_args, {node = arg, reg = ar})
					else
						compileExpr(p, arg, ar)
					end
					na = na + 1
				end
				
				for _, sArg in ipairs(string_args) do
					compileExpr(p, sArg.node, sArg.reg)
				end
				
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, c_base)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, na)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, 1)
				emit(p, OC.M_CALL)
				
				if dst ~= c_base then emitMOVE(p, dst, c_base) end
				
				for _, sArg in ipairs(string_args) do
					emit(p, OC.M_SECURE_ERASE, sArg.reg)
				end
				
				for _ = 1, na + 1 do fR(p) end
			end
		end
	end

	compileStat = function(p, node)
						if node.type == "LocalDefinition" then
			local rs={}
			for _, n in ipairs(node.names) do
				rs[#rs+1]=nL(p, n)
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, rs[#rs]); emitPUSH_LIT(p, rs[#rs]); emit(p, OC.M_LOADNIL)
			end
			for i, valNode in ipairs(node.values) do
				if rs[i] then 
					compileExpr(p, valNode, rs[i]) 
					
					if valNode.type == "CallExpression" and i == #node.values and #rs > i then
						local req_nrv = #rs - i + 1
						for b = #p.c, 1, -1 do
							if p.c[b][1] == OC.M_CALL then
								if p.c[b-1] and p.c[b-1][1] == OC.M_PUSH_LIT then
									p.c[b-1][2] = req_nrv
									local c_base = p.c[b-3][2]
									for j = 1, req_nrv - 1 do
										emitMOVE(p, rs[i + j], c_base + j)
									end
								end
								break
							end
						end
					else
					end
				end
			end
				elseif node.type == "LocalFunctionDefinition" then
			local r=nL(p, node.name)
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, r); emitPUSH_LIT(p, r); emit(p, OC.M_LOADNIL)
			compileExpr(p, node.functionDef, r)
		elseif node.type == "GlobalFunctionDefinition" then
			local chain=node.chain
			local tmp=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.functionDef, tmp)
			if node.isMethod and p.pr[#p.pr] then p.pr[#p.pr].np = p.pr[#p.pr].np+1 end
			
			if #chain==1 then
				local r=fL(p, chain[1])
				if r then emitMOVE(p, r, tmp)
				else 
					local strID, strKey = getOrAddStrKey(p, chain[1])
					emitPUSH_K(p, strID); emitPUSH_REG(p, tmp); emit(p, OC.M_SETGLOBAL, strKey) 
				end
			else
				local tr=aR(p); local r=fL(p, chain[1])
				if r then emitMOVE(p, tr, r)
				else 
					local strID1, strKey1 = getOrAddStrKey(p, chain[1])
					emitPUSH_K(p, strID1); emit(p, OC.M_GETGLOBAL, tr, strKey1) 
				end
				for i=2,#chain-1 do
					local strID_i, strKey_i = getOrAddStrKey(p, chain[i])
					local kr=aR(p); emitPUSH_K(p, strID_i); emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, kr, strKey_i)
					emitPUSH_REG(p, tr); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emit(p, OC.M_GETTABLE, tr); fR(p)
				end
				local strID_l, strKey_l = getOrAddStrKey(p, chain[#chain])
				local kr=aR(p); emitPUSH_K(p, strID_l); emit(p, OC.M_EXEC_SUB, kr, strKey_l)
				emitPUSH_REG(p, tr); emitPUSH_REG(p, kr); emitPUSH_REG(p, tmp); emit(p, OC.M_SETTABLE); fR(p); fR(p)
			end
			fR(p)
		elseif node.type == "ReturnStatement" then
			local nb=#node.arguments
			local base=p.lc
			if nb > 0 then
				for i, arg in ipairs(node.arguments) do
					local r=aR(p); compileExpr(p, arg, r)
				end
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, base); emitPUSH_LIT(p, nb); emit(p, OC.M_RETURN)
				for _=1,nb do fR(p) end
			else
				emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_RETURN)
			end
				elseif node.type == "IfStatement" then
			local done={}
			for _, clause in ipairs(node.clauses) do
				local cr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, clause.condition, cr)
				emitPUSH_REG(p, cr); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_TEST); fR(p)
				local jf=eJMP(p, 0); pushS(p); compileBlock(p, clause.body); popS(p)
				local je=eJMP(p, 0); done[#done+1]=je; patch(p, jf, #p.c + 1)
			end
			if node.elseBody then
				pushS(p); compileBlock(p, node.elseBody); popS(p)
			end
			for _, j in ipairs(done) do patch(p, j, #p.c + 1) end
				elseif node.type == "WhileStatement" then
			local top=#p.c;
			local cr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.condition, cr)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, cr); emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_TEST); fR(p); local jf=eJMP(p, 0)
			p.loopStack = p.loopStack or {}
			table.insert(p.loopStack, {breaks={}, continues={}})
			pushS(p); compileBlock(p, node.body); popS(p)
			local lctx = table.remove(p.loopStack)
			for _, cj in ipairs(lctx.continues) do patch(p, cj, top + 1) end
			eJMP(p, top + 1);
			patch(p, jf, #p.c + 1)
			for _, bj in ipairs(lctx.breaks) do patch(p, bj, #p.c + 1) end
				elseif node.type == "RepeatUntilStatement" then
			local top=#p.c; pushS(p); 
			p.loopStack = p.loopStack or {}
			table.insert(p.loopStack, {breaks={}, continues={}})
			compileBlock(p, node.body); popS(p)
			local lctx = table.remove(p.loopStack)
			local contTarget = #p.c + 1
			for _, cj in ipairs(lctx.continues) do patch(p, cj, contTarget) end
			local cr=aR(p); compileExpr(p, node.condition, cr)
			emitPUSH_REG(p, cr);
			emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); emit(p, OC.M_TEST); fR(p); eJMP(p, top + 1)
			for _, bj in ipairs(lctx.breaks) do patch(p, bj, #p.c + 1) end
				elseif node.type == "ForNumericStatement" then
			pushS(p)
			local ir=nL(p,"__i") local lr=nL(p,"__l") local sr=nL(p,"__s") local vr=nL(p, node.variable)
			compileExpr(p, node.start, ir);
			compileExpr(p, node.limit, lr)
									if node.step then compileExpr(p, node.step, sr) else emitLOADK_NonLinearMBA(p, sr, 1) end
			
			local p_ir1 = emitPUSH_LIT(p, ir);
			local pi2 = emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); 
			emit(p, OC.M_FORPREP)
			
			local bodyStart = #p.c + 1
			emitMOVE(p, vr, ir)
			
			p.loopStack = p.loopStack or {}
			table.insert(p.loopStack, {breaks={}, continues={}})
			
			compileBlock(p, node.body)
			
			local lctx = table.remove(p.loopStack)
			local p_ir2 = emitPUSH_LIT(p, ir);
			for _, cj in ipairs(lctx.continues) do patch(p, cj, p_ir2) end
			
			local li = emitPUSH_LIT(p, 0); 
			emit(p, OC.M_FORLOOP)
			
			patch(p, pi2, p_ir2 + 1)
			patch(p, li, bodyStart)
			
			for _, bj in ipairs(lctx.breaks) do patch(p, bj, #p.c + 1) end
			popS(p)
														elseif node.type == "ForGenericStatement" then
			pushS(p)
			local itr=nL(p,"__it"); local str2=nL(p,"__st");
			local ctl=nL(p,"__ct")
			
			compileExpr(p, node.iterators[1] or {type="Literal",kind="nil"}, itr)
			
						if node.iterators[1] and node.iterators[1].type == "CallExpression" and not node.iterators[2] then
				for b = #p.c, 1, -1 do
					if p.c[b][1] == OC.M_CALL then
						if p.c[b-1] and p.c[b-1][1] == OC.M_PUSH_LIT then
							p.c[b-1][2] = 3
							local c_base = p.c[b-3][2]
							emitMOVE(p, str2, c_base + 1)
							emitMOVE(p, ctl, c_base + 2)
						end
						break
					end
				end
			end

local function peepholeOptimize(proto, OC)
	local superMap = {}
	local superCount = 0
	local usedOpcodes = {}
	for _, val in pairs(OC) do usedOpcodes[val] = true end

			local function fop()
		local val
		repeat val = math.random(1, 65535) until not usedOpcodes[val]
		usedOpcodes[val] = true
		return val
	end

		local reverseOC = {}
	for k, v in pairs(OC) do reverseOC[v] = k end

	local function getName(val)
		return reverseOC[val]
	end

	local safeOpMap = {}
		local function isSafeFast(op)
		if safeOpMap[op] ~= nil then return safeOpMap[op] end
		local opName = reverseOC[op]
		if opName and string.sub(opName, 1, 8) == "M_SUPER_" then 
			safeOpMap[op] = false
			return false 
		end
		local safe = op ~= OC.M_JMP and op ~= OC.M_TEST and op ~= OC.M_EQ and 
					 op ~= OC.M_LT and op ~= OC.M_LE and op ~= OC.M_FORPREP and 
					 op ~= OC.M_FORLOOP and op ~= OC.M_CALL and op ~= OC.M_RETURN and 
					 op ~= OC.M_HALT and op ~= OC.M_EXEC_SUB and 
					 op ~= OC.M_GETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_SETGLOBAL and op ~= OC.M_LOADBOOL
		safeOpMap[op] = safe
		return safe
	end

	local function findAndApply(p)
		local pairsCount = {}
		local function count(p_inner)
			for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
				local op1 = p_inner.c[i][1]
				local op2 = p_inner.c[i+1][1]
				
				if isSafeFast(op1) and isSafeFast(op2) then
					local key = (op1 * 256) + op2
					pairsCount[key] = (pairsCount[key] or 0) + 1
				end
			end
			for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do count(sp) end
		end
		count(p)

		local bestPair, maxCount = nil, 0
		for k, c in pairs(pairsCount) do
			if c > maxCount then maxCount = c; bestPair = k end
		end

		if maxCount >= 2 then
			local o2 = bestPair % 256
			local o1 = math.floor(bestPair / 256)
			
			superCount = superCount + 1
			local superName = "M_SUPER_" .. superCount
			local superVal = fop()
			OC[superName] = superVal
			reverseOC[superVal] = superName 
			superMap[superName] = {getName(o1), getName(o2)}

						local function apply(p_inner)
				local _skip_next = false
				for i = 1, #p_inner.c - 1 do
					if _skip_next then
						_skip_next = false
					elseif p_inner.c[i][1] == o1 and p_inner.c[i+1][1] == o2 then
						p_inner.c[i][1] = superVal
						_skip_next = true
					end
				end
				for _, sp in ipairs(p_inner.pr) do apply(sp) end
			end
			apply(p)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	for iter = 1, 15 do
		if not findAndApply(proto) then break end
	end
	return superMap
end
